
## Application: Lee (2009)

```{r, eval=FALSE}
result.list <- list()
for (week in c(90, 135, 180)) {
  Z <- lee_2009[["treatmnt"]]
  Y <- lee_2009[[paste0("lhrwage", week)]]
  result.list[[paste0("week", week)]] <- application_wrapper(Z = Z, Y = Y, seed = 1)
}

# Generate Latex table for p-value and CI
make_latex_table(result.list)

# Draw the sensitivity analysis plot
plot_sens(sens_pval = result.list$week90$sens_pval, output_file = "application_lee_2009_week90_sens.pdf")
```

## Application: Chen and Yang (2019)

```{r, eval=FALSE}
Z <- chen_and_yang_2019$treatment_vpnnl
Y <- chen_and_yang_2019$az_overall_a_w3
result <- application_wrapper(Z = Z, Y = Y, seed = 1)
result.list <- list(result1 = result)

# Generate LaTex table for p-value and CI
make_latex_table(result.list)

# Draw the sensitivity analysis plot
plot_sens(sens_pval = result$sens_pval, output_file = "application_chen_and_yang_2019_sens.pdf")
```

## Application: Bursztyn et al (2020)

```{r, eval=FALSE}
Z <- bursztyn_et_al_2020$condition2

result <- application_wrapper(Z = Z, Y = Y, seed = 1)
```

## Application: Noy and Zhang (2023)

```{r, eval=FALSE}
result.list <- list()
# outcome 1
Z <- noy_and_zhang_2023$treatment
Y <- -noy_and_zhang_2023$time_diff
result.list[["time_diff"]] <- application_wrapper(Z = Z, Y = Y, seed = 1)

# outcome 2
Z <- noy_and_zhang_2023$treatment
Y <- noy_and_zhang_2023$grade_diff
result.list[["grade_diff"]] <- application_wrapper(Z = Z, Y = Y, seed = 1)

# Generate LaTex table for p-value and CI
make_latex_table(result.list)

# Draw the sensitivity analysis plot
# 1) time_diff
plot_sens(sens_pval = result.list$time_diff$sens_pval, output_file = "application_noy_and_zhang_2023_time_diff_sens.pdf")
  
# 2) grade_diff
plot_sens(sens_pval = result.list$grade_diff$sens_pval, output_file = "application_noy_and_zhang_2023_grade_diff_sens.pdf")
```
